import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    length1 = random.randint(1, 1000)
    length2 = random.randint(1, 1000)
    
    num1 = "".join(random.choice(string.digits) for _ in range(length1))
    num2 = "".join(random.choice(string.digits) for _ in range(length2))

    # Making sure numbers without leading zeros
    num1 = str(int(num1))
    num2 = str(int(num2))
    
    return num1, num2
